reuse.why: Introduces getFillableCategories and setAllCategoriesNMonthAvg used by most actions, but writes its own #fixed regex instead of shared/tags extractTagsFromText and its own goal_def parsing beside goal-template's getTemplates.

duplication.why: Collapses four copied category queries into getFillableCategories, yet copyPreviousMonth re-states the hidden/income/template/#fixed exclusions inline and setLastMonthSpending repeats the expense sign flip that set3MonthAvg and setNMonthAvg also do.

placement.why: The selection logic sits in budget/actions.ts next to the actions that use it and the new action is registered in budget/app.ts like its siblings.

scope.why: Limited to the month-wide actions, registration, tests and release notes.

maintainability.why: Most actions share one selector, but the rule exists twice (getFillableCategories and copyPreviousMonth's inline condition) and the hidden rule is toggled by string-splicing SQL, so a future rule change must be made in two places.

bypasses_abstraction.where: copyPreviousMonth in budget/actions.ts applies its own hidden/income/template/#fixed condition instead of the new getFillableCategories; the #fixed tag test bypasses shared/tags extractTagsFromText.

disguised_duplication.where: copyPreviousMonth reshapes getFillableCategories' exclusion rule into a single inline boolean over budgetData rows (hidden check gated by the flag, templated/fixed sets fetched separately).

abstraction_drift.where: getFillableCategories takes includeHiddenCategories, implemented as a conditional SQL fragment; copyPreviousMonth re-implements the selection instead of calling it.
